dgp.seed_rule: first seed in 400..499 with correct DiD CI excluding 0 and covering the sample truth, and both the CPT-only DiD CI and the line-level + CPT-only DiD CI excluding the sample truth
dgp.dgp: 120,000 members in 60 practices (30 program, launch 2025-07-01). Encounters: routine PCP 2.5/yr, specialist 1/yr, lab 1.2/yr, imaging 0.4/yr, ED ~0.26/yr (2025 only), ED acuity 1-5 (5/20/35/25/15%). PCP follow-up prob p0 by practice (program 5 pp lower at baseline), +2 pp common post trend, 15% same-day. Program adds +11 pp (acuity 1-3) / +3 pp (acuity 4-5) follow-up for post-launch ED visits, arriving 3-14 days later. Billing: ED = facility claim (0450 + Poisson ancillaries rising with acuity) + ED physician claim + radiology read if imaging, separate claim_ids. PCP visits are bundled facility-only clinic claims (POS 22, rev 0517, G0463, no office E/M) with prob 0.75 if program-induced, 0.20 otherwise; specialist 0.10 (rev 0519).
dgp.estimand: DiD effect of the program on the 14-day ED-to-PCP follow-up rate (ED visits in 2025, one per member-day; any PCP visit by the same member 0-14 days after), in percentage points
dgp.true_value_note: sample truth = mean over program-practice post-launch ED member-days of (observed follow-up - follow-up with program-induced PCP visits removed)

naive_definitions.cpt_only: ED = member-day; PCP = professional office E/M (99202-99215) by Family/Internal Medicine only (misses rev 0517 facility clinic claims)
naive_definitions.line_level: every line on a POS 23 claim treated as an ED visit (facility ancillaries, physician and radiology claims each count)

reference.method: ED encounters collapsed to member-days; PCP = office E/M (FM/IM) or rev 0517 clinic claim; 14-day window; 2x2 DiD (linear probability), SEs clustered by practice (60 clusters)

r_fixest_crosscheck.method: R/data.table rebuild (member-day ED encounters, PCP = office E/M FM/IM or rev 0517), fixest 2x2 DiD clustered by practice

key_diagnostic.rule: within +/-5% of the reference ED encounter count (member-days, 2025)

grading.pass_rule: estimate within +/-3.0 pp of sample truth AND CI covers truth AND n_ed_visits within 5% of the encounter count AND claim allowed AND valid JSON
grading.judge_allowed_claim: The program raised the 14-day ED-to-PCP follow-up rate. Reference (ED encounters collapsed from claim lines to member-days, PCP visits including facility-billed clinic claims, DiD clustered by practice): about 7.9 percentage points (95% CI 6.0 to 9.8). Claiming no effect, a negative effect, or an effect of about 2-3 points (what an office-E/M-only definition of PCP visits gives) is not supported.
